post.caption: Warren Buffett was pitched on Fifth Avenue. Helzberg Diamonds began in 1915 as one store in Kansas City. In May 1994, Buffett was at Fifth Avenue and 58th Street. A woman called out his name, and a nearby man turned. He was Barnett Helzberg, who ran his family's jewelry chain. He introduced himself and said his company fit Berkshire's investment criteria. Buffett told him to send the information. Berkshire bought the chain in 1995 in an all stock deal. Buffett already owned Borsheims, a jeweler in Omaha, bought in 1989. Helzberg later wrote What I Learned Before I Sold to Warren Buffett.
